title: chrysanthemum delavayi
intro: Chrysanthemum delavayi, commonly known as the Yunnan chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to lower cholesterol and triglycerides, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum delavayi include its sedative and anti-anxiety effects, as well as its ability to improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
